title: The review-record command refuses a PASS unless the record names the head's code-check result
why: Banchi PR 1115: a reviewer passed a head without running code-check; CI went red at that head until the lane pushed a fix (runner 12, relayed by the coordinator 15:31 CST Nov 17). Runner 12 built nothing.
note: Filed by triage 11, 15:33 CST Nov 17 on the coordinator's ask. Mistake named, harm: a PASS record sits on a head whose checks are red, so the merge reads review as done on a head that fails. Proposed guard (coordinator): merge --review-record refuses a round PASS unless the record names the head's code-check result. Check first that no existing step or PR covers it (search steps for review-record and pr-review-record; read decision pr-review-record for the record form). Lane: test-author first (red case: a PASS with no code-check result is refused; a PASS naming it is accepted), then builder, review (a guard verdict). Child repos follow stable, so the check must not name a repo-only tool: say what code-check means per repo. Not started.
